US Charges Three Men with Plotting Terror Attacks

Three men have been charged in the United States with plotting multiple terrorist attacks, including a planned assault on a UK airbase. One of the accused is an Iran-backed militant who allegedly helped plot the attack on the UK's Fairford base from a US jail. The plots also targeted Jewish communities. The Justice Department announced the charges.
